caption: The drawing features two views of a long-sleeved, floor-length garment, shown from the front and the back, both depicted in grayscale pencil with bright, colored embroidery details. The garment has a fitted bodice, a high collar, and decorative buttons along the front. The front view reveals symmetrical floral embroidery designs in shades of yellow, red, orange, green, white, and blue, arranged vertically along the front seams, cuffs, pockets, and lower hem. The back view highlights similar floral embroidery concentrated on the upper back, cuffs, pocket flaps, and lower skirt panel, with a long, pleated train lined with embroidery at the hem. Additional close-up drawings of smaller sections of the garment, such as a pocket and cuff, show detailed views of the same floral embroidery outlined with red trim. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Dress
